message.content:
Let the rectangle have width \(w\) and height \(h\). Its area is

\[
wh=72
\]

Place coordinates:

\[
A=(0,0),\quad B=(w,0),\quad C=(w,h),\quad D=(0,h)
\]

The midpoint of \(\overline{BC}\) is

\[
M=\left(w,\frac h2\right)
\]

The midpoint of \(\overline{CD}\) is

\[
N=\left(\frac w2,h\right)
\]

The triangle is formed by \(A\), \(M\), and \(N\). Its area is

\[
\frac12 \left| w\cdot h-\frac h2\cdot \frac w2 \right|
\]

\[
=\frac12 \left(wh-\frac{wh}{4}\right)
\]

\[
=\frac12 \cdot \frac{3wh}{4}
\]

\[
=\frac{3wh}{8}
\]

Since \(wh=72\),

\[
\text{Area}=\frac{3\cdot 72}{8}=27
\]

The answer is 27.
